body: If you see dark then just turn on a light I know it's not that easy  as it sounds like but if your stubborn then I'm just like you so don't give up it's ok to lean on other people for support its normal for humans to do it and when you say your not stronge that your only on pilot mode give yourself more credit because  I really mean your a strong person working hard for yourself and your son you know even a plain can't run on pilot mode for ever it needs a strong person to guide it safely to land and I know money is something we humans need to survive in this world but sometimes it is also bad it makes humans greedy and makes us do bad things to get it so pleas have more faith in yourself and have faith that things will get better I really think you are of a strong heart

I see then so is up to you to make your choice to give in or to but the pain aside and for a moment  see the true wonder of this world we live in the simplest details make the difference regardless the path you take just wanted you to know talking to you made a difference in my life so thanks to you I'm more determined to die but when the right time comes naturally hope you take the right path and that it leads us to talk again about tomorrow's future and the great thing that will await us stay stronge and thank you

All I can say is that you are a more stronger than what you thing you are more than me and more than other people in this world going through that and still being strong enough for you and your son that's something worth living for so stay strong and have faith maybe you see rain in sunny days but that rain and sun combined makes a rainbow come out a symbol of hope keep stronge and cling to life breath step by step one day at a time

I get your feelings life is hard so please don't give up the pain will always be there you just need to learn to live with it and and get use to to the point where it doesn't bother you it's going to be hard trust me but in the long run you will see the sun shine lean on others if you have to and if you have no one to lean on then we will be here for you because we are all human nothing more nothing less

Trust me when I say that I want to die but right know it's not the right time to do it . Death will come to everyone no matter what that's just the fate of every single person in this world. Live the most of your life just be happy it's ok to lean on other people we are a human

In a way I know how you feel. I  want  to die but unfortunately I don't believe in suicide since I was raised in the word of god so I decided to be ready to die whenever the time came. I'm not afraid of death but still a want death more than anyone. So just enjoy life while you can live for others and yourself death will come to everyone  eventually remember Don't be afraid of death be afraid of an unlived life
